body:
Looks at the code, the change makes e.g. `res://SomeFolder/Node2D.jpg` fetch `Node2D` icon from the theme. That's rather awkward fallback. If anything, it should use the path as type name (so effectively the icon path would become "path or type").

Your solution allows to use arbitrary editor icons for custom types, so unless it's something you actually need, see if #108607 resolves your problem instead.

> That's rather awkward fallback.

I disagree, the reason I coded it like this is threefold:
- Retrocompatiblity, people need not update their gdextension file, just erase the icons from their project folder.
- Homogenity, since people can always point at icons at the same folder, e.g. addons/icons, even if no icon exists there, the name would be use to give an icon.
- Robust against errors, since if something happens to an actual icon someone was trying to use, then it shows the correct default instead for that name. (Making a custom Sprite2D.svg, for example)

If none of this is of substance, or important enough, I can change it, but I can't see using the filename instead of the full path for icon resolution to be an issue for someone. That said, I have no problem changing my implementation if that's what decided to be better.

> Your solution allows to use arbitrary editor icons for custom types.

That was my point exactly, yes. For example, if I make an EditorPlugin that is a build script launcher, then I'd rather use Tool.svg than EditorPlugin.svg, as it explains better what it does.
